note: GTA V's own settings that Leonida locks for the chosen pack, variant and PC (leonida/gamesettings.py). Values are settings.xml's strings. Rule order: values tuned on this PC (`leonida settings tune`), the chosen variant, the graphics card's tier (gpuTiers, Enhanced), then the first matching PC condition, then whenSelected, then packs, then value; no value = not locked. Only keys whose meaning is known are locked; shadows, reflections and the rest stay with the game's own auto-detection (configSource SMC_AUTO).

video/Windowed/@value.label: Screen type: Windowed Borderless
video/Windowed/@value.why: the GTA VI HUD's minimap only draws in Windowed Borderless (its guide); 0 = full screen, 1 = windowed, 2 = borderless

graphics/TextureQuality/@value.label: Texture quality
graphics/TextureQuality/@value.why: from the graphics card's tier (video memory); measured on the owner's 8 GB GTX 1070: Very High peaks at 4.0-4.5 GB of 8 GB with the whole pack (37 play tests, 2026-11-25/26)

graphics/GrassQuality/@value.label: Grass quality
graphics/GrassQuality/@value.why: from the graphics card's tier; Ultra is the game's own choice for an 8 GB GTX 1070

graphics/CityDensity/@value.label: Population density: 80%
graphics/CityDensity/@value.why: fewer people and cars at once: less memory next to Traffic V's DLC cars and the map mods (on the owner's 16 GB PC the full pack crashed while loading when free memory was low)

graphics/PedVarietyMultiplier/@value.label: Population variety: 80%
graphics/PedVarietyMultiplier/@value.why: fewer different ped models loaded at once (memory)

graphics/VehicleVarietyMultiplier/@value.label: Vehicle variety: 80%
graphics/VehicleVarietyMultiplier/@value.why: fewer different car models loaded at once (memory); Traffic V and the vehicle packs add many

graphics/MaxLodScale/@value.label: Extended distance scaling: off
graphics/MaxLodScale/@value.why: extended distance scaling keeps far more of the map in memory

graphics/HdStreamingInFlight/@value.label: High detail streaming while flying: off
graphics/HdStreamingInFlight/@value.why: it streams high-detail models in while flying, on top of the mods' extra map content (memory)

graphics/Raytracing_Enabled/@value.label: Ray tracing: off
graphics/Raytracing_Enabled/@value.why: this graphics card has no ray-tracing hardware (off); AuraV's path tracing needs it on (RTX cards)

graphics/ResScalingType/@value.label: Upscaling: off
graphics/ResScalingType/@value.why: no DLSS on this card; FSR upscaling stays off (players fix FSR-related crashes by setting ResScalingType to 0). Unlock it to try FSR yourself

graphics/FrameGenType/@value.label: Frame generation: off
graphics/FrameGenType/@value.why: DLSS frame generation needs an RTX 40 or 50 card, and FSR 3 frame generation leaves the game buggy (player reports)

graphics/ShadowQuality/@value.label: Shadow quality
graphics/ShadowQuality/@value.why: from the graphics card's tier (video memory), or raised by `leonida settings tune` on this PC

gpuTiers.why: the game's own auto-detected choice for an 8 GB GTX 1070 (configSource SMC_AUTO); measured with the whole owner's pick: peak video memory 4.0-4.5 GB of 8 GB at story mode (37 play tests)
6 GB cards: Very High textures fit (they peak at about 4.5 GB on 8 GB), the rest one step lower; not measured yet, `leonida settings tune` raises what fits
4 GB cards: High textures, the rest two steps lower; not measured yet
cards under 4 GB (or unknown video memory: the tier isn't applied then)

tune.note: knownCrash: values a play test crashed at on a PC (key -> [values]); the tune never tries them. None is known yet: the owner's loading crash is memory pressure, not one setting.
